title: OrthoGather: a local platform for orthology-based proteome comparisons and Gene Ontology enrichment
description:
A locally hosted web application that integrates orthology inference with Gene Ontology enrichment for comparative proteome analysis. It retrieves reference and non-reference proteomes from UniProt, runs OrthoFinder to infer orthogroups, explores orthogroup composition across species through interactive UpSet plots, and tests Gene Ontology over-representation. Every analysis carries a provenance record of the software and database versions behind it.

OrthoGather is described in the preprint https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.01.30.702851. The worked example from the paper is included in the example_analysis/ folder, and installation instructions are in docs/Installation_guide.pdf.
